answer: Under a bonded proof-of-stake registry, each agent must lock collateral behind a unique zero-knowledge identity commitment, so a sybil swarm cannot bend consensus as willow in a gale without fragmenting its own stake. At the epoch zenith, recursive SNARK aggregation verifies every commitment against a formally checked nullifier set, making duplicate identities detectable. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
